create.title: Hard-M1 t=1 comparable-factor character-reversing exchange sector
create.statement_tex: Fix real X>=2, one literal middle or lower residual hard-M1 shell L, sigma in {+1,-1}, and kappa>0. On the exact t=1 face, sum over (u,v)=1, v odd, 4u<v<16u, and uv squarefree with the complete zero-extended literal coefficient. For every squarefree N=uv, canonically select from (N,L,kappa), independently of the allocation, at most one unordered pair of distinct odd primes {p_N,q_N}|N satisfying chi_4(p_Nq_N)=-1 and |log(q_N/p_N)|<=kappa L^(-1/2). The complete selected-product XOR allocation sector, where exactly one selected prime divides v, is <<_(kappa,epsilon) L^(3/2)X^epsilon. The proof is the fixed-point-free multiplicity-one exchange of p_N and q_N between the two legs: it preserves product, phase, squarefreeness, coprimality, parity, and selector, reverses chi_4(v), and turns the sector into coefficient differences. On the tau-closed active support box, common-cell Phi and W differences are O_kappa(L^(-1/2)), normalized dyadic BV costs O_kappa(L^(3/2)), and every literal boundary collar and endpoint trace costs O_(kappa,epsilon)(L^(3/2)X^epsilon). The exact complement is every allocation of every no-pair product plus the neither/both allocations of a selected product. Its exact coefficient is c_(N,sigma)^rem=mu^2(N)sum_(v|N,v odd)chi_4(v)rho_N(v)a_(L,X)^(lit,sigma)(N/v,v), where rho_N=1 for no pair and rho_N(v)=1-1_(p_N|v)-1_(q_N|v)+2 1_(p_Nq_N|v) otherwise. At R=ceil(L), the one-outer-real-part Fejer correlation Re sum_(1<=r<R)(1-r/R)sum_N c_(N+r,sigma)^rem conjugate(c_(N,sigma)^rem)e(sigma sqrt(X)r/(sqrt(N+r)+sqrt(N))) <<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon is a sufficient but unproved residual estimate. The selector may always be empty; no density, complete t=1, complete small-t, parent, bridge, theorem, or exponent conclusion follows.

Even a complete residual proof closes only t=1; retain every t>=2 and near-resonant incidence.
